insert into private.weekly_source_office_row_choices(upload_row_id,candidate_id,client_id,contract_id,actor_user_id,work_event_id,match_reason,separate_shift,
      pay_effect,paid_overlap_target_work_event_id,paid_overlap_inputs_json,paid_overlap_inputs_sha256)
      values(v_row.id,v_candidate,v_client,v_contract,v_actor,v_work_event,v_match_reason,v_separate_shift,
        coalesce(v_paid_choice->>'pay_effect','NORMAL'),(v_paid_choice->>'paid_overlap_target_work_event_id')::uuid,

        'WEEKLY_SOURCE_PAID_SHIFT_MATCH_CONFIRMED',null,

          'choice',to_jsonb(v_choice),'request',p_request,'request_sha256',encode(v_hash,'hex'),
